metadata.title: The penalty
metadata.user_prompt: The story of a kid who is about to kick a penalty. He is anxious. Then he remembers recommendations from his coach to stay calm and then he scores.

pages.text: Había una vez un niño llamado Carlos que amaba jugar al fútbol más que nada en el mundo. Un día, durante el juego más importante de la temporada, su equipo estuvo empatado y el juego se redujo a la tanda de penaltis. Carlos fue elegido para disparar el último penalti. Sentía una gran presión. Le temblaban las piernas y tenía miedo de fallar. Miró alrededor y vio a todos sus amigos y familiares animándolo. Sabía que tenía que hacerlo por ellos.

pages.text: En ese momento, recordó las palabras de su entrenador, el Señor Luis, quien siempre decía: "Carlos, debes mantener la calma. Recuerda, el fútbol es solo un juego. No importa si ganas o pierdes, lo más importante es que te diviertas". Carlos cerró los ojos, respiró hondo y se calmó. Se sintió más seguro y listo para enfrentar el reto. Agarró la pelota con fuerza, la colocó en el punto de penal y retrocedió unos pasos.

pages.text: Carlos miró al portero, luego a la pelota y luego al arco. Recordó todos los entrenamientos y cómo golpeó la pelota una y otra vez. Sabía exactamente lo que tenía que hacer. Con un suspiro, tomó impulso y corrió hacia la pelota. Pateó con todas sus fuerzas y... ¡GOL! La multitud estalló en vítores. Carlos no podía creerlo. Había marcado el gol de la victoria para su equipo. A pesar de su miedo inicial, se mostró valiente y demostró que con coraje y calma, podemos lograr cualquier cosa.

characters.name: Carlos
characters.physical_description: Carlos is a 10-year-old boy with a medium build. He stands at about 4 feet 5 inches tall. He has short, curly black hair and brown eyes. His skin is a warm, medium brown color. His face is round with a small, upturned nose and full cheeks. He has a wide, bright smile that shows his white teeth.
characters.clothing: Carlos is typically seen wearing his favorite soccer uniform which is a bright red jersey with the number '10' printed in white on the back, black shorts with white stripes on the sides, long white socks, and black soccer cleats. He also wears a black and white checkered bandana around his head.
characters.distinctive_features: Carlos's most distinctive feature is his black and white checkered bandana that he always wears during his soccer games. He also has a small scar on his right knee from a soccer injury.
characters.personality_traits: Carlos's personality is reflected in his determined expression and confident posture. His wide smile and bright eyes show his love for soccer and his enthusiasm for the game. His clenched fists and focused gaze during the penalty kick scene show his courage and determination.

characters.name: Señor Luis
characters.physical_description: Señor Luis is a middle-aged man with a medium build. He stands about 5'8" tall and has a slightly rounded belly. He has dark brown skin and a full head of black hair, which is always neatly combed back. His eyes are small and brown, always sparkling with kindness. He has a thick, well-groomed mustache that sits above his wide, friendly smile. His hands are large and calloused from years of playing and coaching football.
characters.clothing: Señor Luis is always seen in his coaching attire. He wears a bright red tracksuit with white stripes down the sides. On his feet, he wears black athletic shoes with white laces. Around his neck, he has a whistle on a black lanyard.
characters.distinctive_features: Señor Luis's most distinctive feature is his thick black mustache. He also always wears a red cap with the team's logo on it, which he only removes to wipe his brow during intense games.
characters.personality_traits: Señor Luis's friendly and encouraging nature is evident in his warm smile and kind eyes. His passion for football and dedication to his team can be seen in the way he always wears his team's colors and logo. His calm and patient demeanor is reflected in his steady gaze and relaxed posture.
